questions.prompt: How will the number -8'd4 (in Verilog) be internally represented as bits?
Which of the following data types can store value during Verilog simulation?
options: wire
wand
wor
reg

questions.prompt: The variable A contains the bit sequence {1011}. The variable Y is obtained by applying the reduction operator: Y=|A. What will be the final value of Y?
options: X
Z

questions.prompt: Which of the following statements about non-blocking assignments in Verilog is incorrect?
options: The execution of the next statement is done after the current non-blocking assignment is fully executed
The symbol for non-blocking assignment is <=
The execution of the next statement is not blocked until the current non-blocking assignment is executed
The RHS of a non-blocking assignment can be a Verilog expression
questions.accepted: The execution of the next statement is done after the current non-blocking assignment is fully executed

questions.prompt: Which of the following statements is incorrect about a Verilog function?
options: A function can have one or more inputs
A function will have one output
A function can call another function
A function can call another task
questions.accepted: A function can call another task

questions.prompt: Which of the following tasks is typically NOT performed by a testbench in simulation-based RTL verification:
options: Interact with the simulator
Applies stimulus
Observes the response
Perform logic synthesis

questions.prompt: Which of the following statements is incorrect about code coverage:
options: Help identify sections of DUV's source code that did not execute during verification.
Help perform timing analysis of the design
Helps monitor the progress of the verification effort
Helps assess the quality of verification
questions.accepted: Help perform timing analysis of the design

questions.prompt: An event-based RTL simulator keeps the events ordered in the event queue according to:
options: Speed of the processor on which simulation is run
Randomly
Simulation time of the event
Delay of circuit elements in the synthesized netlist

questions.prompt: Which of the following Verilog constructs is processed last in the stratified Verilog event queue
options: continuous assign statement
blocking assignment
LHS of non-blocking assignment
RHS of non-blocking assignment

questions.prompt: Which of the following statements is incorrect about race in RTL simulation
options: Race in RTL simulation signifies that the circuit is operating very fast
Due to race, we can obtain different results when the order of execution of two or more statements is changed (as permitted by IEEE standard)
Races in RTL simulation can be difficult to debug
Races can be avoided by following some guidelines in RTL coding
questions.accepted: Race in RTL simulation signifies that the circuit is operating very fast
